source.detail: Regression fixture for GitHub issue #38 (https://github.com/0verme/dbx-plugin-plan-detective/issues/38): synthetic minimal MySQL 8.0 EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON table access whose cost_info.data_read_per_join is a human-readable byte size ("167K") instead of a plain numeric string. The shape mirrors the reporter's real plan (query_block -> table, access_type ALL, rows_examined_per_scan / rows_produced_per_join, filtered, cost_info) without copying the user's SQL, schema or table names. The size encoding was verified against MySQL Server 8.0 human_readable_num_bytes() (include/m_string.h): 1024-based, integer-only, with an optional K/M/G/T/P/E/Z/Y suffix. Table name, columns, row counts and costs are neutralized synthetic test data.
